title: Gottfried Leibniz in his World: The Making of a Savant (1672–1679)
lineage: Inspected source passages; local file is paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: Pages 47–49 describe Huygens mentoring Leibniz after his return to Paris in 1673, mathematical reading and problem-setting, and Leibniz’s later 1675 calculus.
